name: ai-engineering-hub
description: In-depth tutorials on LLMs, RAGs and real-world AI agent applications.
one_liner: A big free library of over 90 hands-on tutorial projects for building things with AI — chatbots, document search, AI agents — organized from beginner to advanced, with working code for each one.
buyer: An aspiring AI developer or a company training up its engineers who wants concrete, working examples instead of starting from theory or a blank page.
business_use_cases: A bootcamp or corporate training program uses the beginner-to-advanced structure as a ready-made curriculum instead of building one from scratch.
A freelance AI consultant uses specific project templates (e.g. the agentic RAG examples) as a fast starting point for client work, billing for the customization.

money_ideas.idea: A paid 'cohort' course or workshop that walks a paying audience through the free repo's projects live, charging for structure and support rather than the content.
Sponsored project additions or sponsored tool integrations within the hub (already partly monetized via the newsletter/eBook funnel).

steal_this: Pick the three most-requested beginner projects, record a tight paid video walkthrough for each, and sell that as a cheap companion course this weekend.
